{{Quote|Have we underestimated these infidels?''"<br />"''Only their blind good fortune.|[[High Prefect]] [[Drathul]] and [[Nom Anor]]|<ref name="Hero's Trial" />}}
The '''Battle of Bilbringi''' was an engagement fought on the outskirts of the [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi system]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], and resulted from the ambush of a [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]], the ''[[Queen of Empire]]'', by the forces of the [[Peace Brigade]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Your part in this was to arrange for New Republic victories, to ensure that Elan was well appraised.|[[Supreme Commander]] [[Nas Choka]], to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Tla]]|<ref name="Hero's Trial" />}}
The [[Peace Brigade]], which was collaborating with the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], a [[Species/Legends|race]] of [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] which had [[Yuuzhan Vong War|attacked]] [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], boarded the ''Queen of Empire'' to retrieve a Yuuzhan Vong defector, the [[Priest caste|priestess]] [[Elan]]. Unbeknownst to [[Reck Desh]], who was leading the Peace Brigade operatives, Elan was a bogus defector, and secretly an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] attempting to make contact with the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] in order to kill as many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as possible. When the Yuuzhan Vong discovered that Desh and his cohorts were attempting to return Elan to them before her mission was completed, they dispatched [[Executor (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Executor]] [[Nom Anor]] with a Yuuzhan Vong [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] to stall the Peace Brigade.

==The battle==
{{Quote|It was a costly enterprise, Supreme Commander. Many coralskippers were sacrificed, and several small warships were destroyed.|[[Battle Tactician|Tactician]] [[Raff]], to Supreme Commander Nas Choka|<ref name="Hero's Trial" />}}
The battle grew increasingly complicated as the ''[[Thurse]]'', a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] carrier, arrived to defend the ''Queen of Empire'', and both the Yuuzhan Vong frigate and the ''Thurse'' engaged one another. Desh, who had extracted Elan from the ''Queen of Empire'', led the priestess towards the Yuuzhan Vong frigate aboard one of his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], with the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in pursuit. Executor Anor attempted to keep the shuttle at bay, sacrificing many of his [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to do so, in order that the ''Millennium Falcon'' could recapture the priestess. As it happened, however, Elan's duplicity was discovered by the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and the assassin subsequently perished, killed by her own bioweapon. [[Vergere]] managed to flee in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. With the operation a failure, Executor Anor retreated his forces, and the engagement was brought to a close.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Our Master met Vergere while he was a captive of the Yuuzhan Vong. She liked his vision of One Sith. But after the first Battle of Bilbringi, she escaped the Yuuzhan Vong and met Lumiya. And Lumiya convinced her that our Master's plan was too slow; that by the time One Sith were ready to act, Skywalker's Jedi would be too strong to defeat.|[[White Eyes]], to [[Alema Rar]]|<ref name="Inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>}}
After her escape from the ''Millennium Falcon'' during the latter stages of the battle, Vergere eventually met [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]], whereupon the two hatched their plan to create a new [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].<ref name="Inferno" />

The [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi system]] would eventually be [[Attack on the Bilbringi system|captured]] by the Yuuzhan Vong invaders in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="Atlas" />
